result.instructions: Tools for Getfly CRM, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customers were added to Getfly CRM this week?"; "Show the open opportunities in my main sales campaign and their stages."; "List my sales orders from last month that are still unpaid.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Getfly CRM data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run getfly_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run getfly_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run getfly_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. getfly_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: getfly_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the Getfly CRM users (employees): user id, name, department, email, phone. Use the user_name (login name) for the recipient/manager arguments of the create tools. Filters: user_id, contact_name, email, contact_mobile, valid (1 = active users). GET /api/v6.1/users.

sort.description: Field to sort by (e.g. id, created_at, updated_at). Default: newest id first.

direction.description: Sort direction, used with sort (default asc).

offset.description: Records to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

fields.description: Comma-separated field names to return (e.g. id,account_name,email). Leave empty for the default set.

filters.description: Filters as { "field": value } or { "field:operator": value }; operators eq, is, in, not_in, contains, between, not_between, gte, gt, lte, lt. in, not_in, between and not_between take an array. Examples: {"email:contains":"@acme.com"}, {"id:in":[1,2,3]}, {"created_at:between":["2026-10-01 00:00:00","2026-10-31 23:59:59"]}.

tools.name: getfly_list_accounts
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (accounts, i.e. companies or individuals) with code, name, phone, email, address, type, source, relationship, manager, total revenue and contacts. Filters: id, account_code, account_name, phone_office, email, account_type, account_source, relation_id, industry, billing_address_street, created_at, updated_at (gte/lte/between), account_manager (user id), sale_order_status. Newest first. GET /api/v6/accounts.

tools.name: getfly_get_account
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer by its customer code (account_code, e.g. KH/2025/000001): full profile with contacts, custom fields, type, source, industry, manager and revenue. GET /api/v6.1/account?account_code=.

fields.description: Comma-separated field names to return (e.g. id,account_name,email). Leave empty for the default set.

tools.name: getfly_create_account
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: Create a new customer (account) in Getfly CRM. The customer code must be unique (leave it out to let Getfly generate one). Type, source, industry, relationship, country, province, district and ward are given by NAME and must match the names configured in Getfly. Optionally adds one primary contact. Creating records may trigger the workflows and notifications set up in the CRM. POST /api/v6.1/account.

account_manager_username.description: Login name of the managing user (getfly_list_users → user_name).

custom_fields.description: Custom field values by field key.

tools.name: getfly_update_account
tools.title: Update customer
tools.description: WRITE: Update fields of an existing customer, found by its current customer code. Send only the fields to change. Names (relationship, country, province...) must match those configured in Getfly. Contacts and the type/source/industry lists are not editable here. PUT /api/v6.1/account.

account_code.description: New customer code, only to rename the code.

account_manager_username.description: Login name of the new managing user.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values by field key.

tools.name: getfly_create_opportunity
tools.title: Create opportunity
tools.description: WRITE: Create a sales opportunity in a campaign for a customer and assign it to a user. Creates (or links) the customer and contact from the details given. The assigned user and the campaign rules may be notified by Getfly. POST /api/v6.1/opportunity.

recipient_username.description: Login name of the user who handles it (getfly_list_users → user_name).

account_code.description: Existing customer code, if the customer already exists.

tools.name: getfly_move_opportunity_stage
tools.title: Move opportunity to a pipeline stage
tools.description: WRITE: Move an opportunity to another stage of its campaign pipeline, without changing anything else. Identify the opportunity by code (or id) and the campaign by code (or id); the new stage by name (or status id) from getfly_get_campaign_stages. Won/lost/cancelled results are not set here. PUT /api/v6.1/opportunity/stage.

opportunity_code.description: Opportunity code. Use this or opportunity_id.

campaign_code.description: Campaign code. Use this or campaign_id.

opportunity_status_name.description: New stage name. Use this or opportunity_status.

annotations.title: Move opportunity to a pipeline stage
